reviews.title: Like it Just maybe not all of it
reviews.text: I’m glad everyone else is enjoying this app but One thing this app is great for birding but I didn’t understand all of it. It was kind of hard to play or use after all  It was fine. This isn’t my biggest recommendation though. there is other apps that I enjoy more or less sorry if you don’t understand a lot of things or don’t like complex apps don’t use this I don’t think I knew how to play it but still if you don’t like very detailed apps or games for birding don’t use this

reviews.title: Lost its hearing.
reviews.text: My app suddenly cannot hear even the loudest birds.

reviews.title: App crashes constantly
reviews.text: I want to love this app but I can’t even use it. Want to identify a bird? Crazy. Upload a video? Crash. Use sound ID? Crash. Change your location of a sighting? Crash. Upload photo? Crash.
